title: 第15章 丹师猫的启蒙第16章 呼噜催生与地脉节点
slug: 喵仙宗主从猫薄荷开始证道长生
content_zh:
＞剑齿猫武士的利爪撕裂王莽手臂，三个外门弟子狼狈逃窜。
＞危机解除，林墨却发现三花玳瑁猫正专注扒拉废弃丹炉里的药渣。
＞小家伙用爪子捻起焦黑残渣凑近鼻尖，尾巴兴奋地左右摆动。
＞当林墨好奇靠近，三花猫竟将沾满药灰的爪子按上他裤脚——
＞一段残缺的古老丹方石板，被它从废墟深处拖了出来。
---
灵田边缘弥漫着淡淡的血腥气和浓得化不开的猫薄荷异香。
王莽三人逃窜时留下的零星血迹，在深褐色泥土上格外刺眼，如同几朵不祥的墨梅。
林墨蹲下身，指尖拂过被抓伤了背脊的警戒组大橘猫。
小家伙身体还在微微发抖，喉咙里发出委屈的呜咽。
一丝微弱的灵力，混合着源自猫男体质本能的安抚气息，从林墨掌心渡了过去。
大橘紧绷的身体这才慢慢松弛，脑袋依赖地蹭了蹭林墨的手腕。
“疤面，”
林墨抬头，看向脸上伤疤更显狰狞的独眼猫，“带它去石屋后面，用我存的那点清水清洗伤口。”
疤面低应一声，金色独眼警惕地扫视着王莽等人消失的山道方向，这才小心地叼起大橘的后颈皮，迈着沉稳的步子离开。
铁爪（林墨已经默认了这个名字）无声地走到林墨身边，进化后更显庞大的身躯投下阴影，带着金属寒光的剑齿在午后的阳光下闪烁。
它微微低头，暗金色的瞳孔看向林墨，带着无声的询问——是否追击？
林墨摇摇头，猫耳警觉地转动，捕捉着风中残留的咒骂和远去的脚步声。
“穷寇莫追，让他们滚。”
他拍了拍铁爪肌肉虬结的前肢，触手是岩石般的坚硬和温热，“干得漂亮，铁爪！

以后，你就是我们废丹峰猫群的‘爪牙’！”
铁爪喉咙里发出一声低沉而满足的呼噜，如同闷雷滚过。
守护的意志，在它磐石般的眼神里更加坚定。
猫群在最初的惊吓后，重新被猫薄荷的异香安抚。
大部分猫又回到了它们那迷醉的“天堂状态”
，打滚的、蹭叶子的、呆坐的灵魂出窍的，混乱中透着一股劫后余生的慵懒。
然而，一道忙碌的小小身影却与这慵懒格格不入，牢牢抓住了林墨的视线。
是那只在冲突发生时，就异常焦急地绕着某株猫薄荷打转的三花玳瑁猫。
此刻，它正蹲在灵田边缘那片倒塌的废弃丹炉废墟旁，小小的脑袋几乎要埋进堆积如山的黑灰色药渣里。
它的动作专注得近乎虔诚。
沾着泥土的爪子小心翼翼地扒开那些不知积存了多少年、散发着复杂刺鼻气味的焦黑残渣。
每扒开一小堆，它就凑近鼻子，小巧的鼻翼快速翕动，发出极其细微的“咻咻”
声。
有时，它会突然停顿，暗绿色的猫眼猛地亮起，像是发现了稀世珍宝，伸出带着倒刺的粉红舌头，极其珍惜地舔舐一下爪尖沾上的某种粉末。
更多时候，它会皱起鼻子，喉咙里发出嫌弃的“噗噗”
声，小爪子飞快地把那堆“不受欢迎”
的药渣刨到一边，仿佛多停留一秒都是折磨。
它完全沉浸在自己的世界里，尾巴尖以一种奇特的、带着韵律的小幅度快速摆动，显示出内心的兴奋与专注。
阳光透过稀疏的枯枝落在它油光水滑的三色皮毛上，跳跃着温暖的光斑。
它守护的那株猫薄荷，是整片灵田里最茂盛的一株，银灰色的叶片比其他植株更加肥厚宽大，边缘的锯齿在光线下流转着近乎金属的冷冽光泽，散发出的香气也格外霸道清凉。

林墨心中一动，放轻脚步走了过去，尽量不惊扰它。
他在距离几步远的地方蹲下，饶有兴致地看着这小家伙忙碌。
content_en:
>The sharp claws of the saber-tooth cat warrior tore Wang Mang's arm, and the three outer disciples fled in confusion.
>The crisis was over, but Lin Mo found that the three-flowered tortoiseshell cat was focused on pulling out the dregs of medicine in the abandoned alchemy furnace.
>The little guy picked up the charred remains with his paws and brought it close to the tip of his nose, his tail swaying from side to side excitedly.
＞When Lin Mo approached out of curiosity, the calico cat pressed its paws covered with medicine ash onto his trouser legs——
>A fragmented ancient Danfang stone slab was dragged out from the depths of the ruins.
---
The edge of the spiritual field was filled with the faint smell of blood and the overwhelmingly strong scent of catnip.
The sporadic blood stains left behind by Wang Mang and the others when they fled were particularly dazzling on the dark brown soil, like a few ominous plum blossoms.
Lin Mo knelt down and brushed his fingertips against the big orange cat of the security team whose back was scratched.
The little guy's body was still trembling slightly, and he whimpered aggrievedly from his throat.
A faint trace of spiritual power, mixed with the soothing aura originating from the cat man's physical instinct, passed through Lin Mo's palm.
Daju's tense body slowly relaxed, and his head rubbed against Lin Mo's wrist dependently.
"Scarface,"
Lin Mo raised his head and looked at the one-eyed cat whose scars on his face were even more hideous. "Take it to the back of the stone house and clean the wound with the little water I saved."
Scarface gave a low response, and his golden single eye scanned the direction of the mountain road where Wang Mang and others disappeared. Then he carefully picked up the skin of the back of the big orange in his mouth and left with a steady step.
Iron Claw (Lin Mo had already acquiesced to this name) walked silently to Lin Mo's side. His evolved, larger body cast a shadow, and his saber teeth with cold metallic light flashed in the afternoon sun.
It lowered its head slightly and looked at Lin Mo with its dark golden pupils, asking silently - should we pursue him?
Lin Mo shook his head, his cat ears turning alertly, catching the lingering curses in the wind and the sound of distant footsteps.
"Don't chase the poor bandits, let them get away."
He patted Iron Claw’s muscular forelimbs, the tentacles were as hard and warm as rock, “Well done, Iron Claw!
From now on, you will be the 'minion' of our useless Danfeng cats! "
Iron Claw let out a low and contented snore from his throat, like thunder rolling past.
The will to protect is even more determined in its rock-like eyes.
After the initial fright, the cats were once again soothed by the scent of catnip.
Most cats are back to their intoxicated "paradise state"
, rolling around, rubbing leaves, sitting still and having an out-of-body experience. There is a sense of laziness in the aftermath of a disaster in the chaos.
However, a busy little figure was incompatible with this laziness and firmly caught Lin Mo's sight.
It was the calico tortoiseshell cat that anxiously circled a certain catnip plant when a conflict occurred.
At this moment, it was squatting beside the ruins of the collapsed abandoned alchemy furnace at the edge of the spiritual field, its small head almost buried in the mountains of black and gray medicine residue.
Its movements were almost religious.
The muddy claws carefully peeled away the charred remains that had been accumulated for countless years and exuded a complex and pungent smell.
Every time a small pile is opened, it comes close to the nose, its small nose flaps rapidly, and makes an extremely subtle "whoosh"
sound.
Sometimes, it would pause suddenly, its dark green cat eyes suddenly light up, as if it had discovered a rare treasure, and it would stretch out its barbed pink tongue and lick some kind of powder on the tips of its claws with great treasure.
More often, it will wrinkle its nose and make a "puff" of disgust in its throat.
With a loud sound, the little paws quickly removed the pile of "unwelcome"
The dregs of the medicine were scraped to one side, as if staying there for a second longer was torture.
It was completely immersed in its own world, and the tip of its tail swung rapidly in a strange, rhythmic small amplitude, showing its inner excitement and concentration.
The sun shines through the sparse dead branches and falls on its oily, three-color fur, dancing with warm light spots.
The catmint plant it guards is the most lush one in the entire spiritual field, and its silver-gray leaves are thicker than the others.The plants are thicker and wider, and the jagged edges have an almost metallic cold sheen under the light, and the aroma they emit is particularly overbearing and cool.
Lin Mo's heart moved and he walked over lightly, trying not to disturb it.
He squatted down a few steps away and watched the little guy busy with interest.
